name: Vanity Number
summary: Marketplace for memorable North American local and toll-free phone numbers, sold as a one-time purchase and ported to the carrier or VoIP service you already use.
best_for: US and Canadian businesses that want a memorable local or toll-free number for advertising, vehicles or signage and keep it on the carrier they already use
skip_if: you need the phone service itself (call routing, a business phone app or minutes), you are outside North America, or you want the option of a refund
honest_knock: Refunds are not possible, and not every carrier accepts every number, so the buyer has to confirm the port with their own carrier first. You are buying the number only: calls, lines and any phone system stay on your existing carrier bill. What you get is the right to use the number at your carrier, not a title to it; let service lapse everywhere and the FAQ says it eventually returns to the pool. We have not bought a number ourselves.

pricing.entry_price_terms: cheapest number · one-time search and acquisition fee per number, rising with how memorable it is
pricing.notes: (read 2026-10-11 on vanitynumber.com and its FAQ page, USD) VanityNumber.com sells memorable North American local and toll-free phone numbers as a one-time purchase, not phone service. The FAQ says the price is a single search and acquisition fee to source the number, secure it and transfer it to the carrier you choose; there is no monthly subscription, renewal or fee for keeping the number, and your carrier keeps billing you for lines and calls as before. Prices start at $99.99 and rise with how memorable the number is. The catalogue is browsable by price band, from under $250 through $251 to $500, $501 to $1,000, $1,001 to $2,500 and $2,501 to $10,000 to over $10,000, and the rarest numbers are quoted on request. On the home page that day, numbers on sale were listed at $199.99 and $299.99 against $359.99, and at $200 against $290; double-repeater VIP numbers were listed at $2,000 to $3,000, and a banner offered 30% off specially marked numbers. The FAQ says refunds are not possible.

schema_offer.description: cheapest number, one-time search and acquisition fee per number, rising with how memorable it is; no subscription; your carrier bills calls and lines separately. Read on the vendor's own pricing page on 2026-10-11.

price_history.method: Stable = every amount on the vendor's pricing page identical across >= 3 of our reads over >= 30 days. A change is listed only after we confirmed the new price on the page, with a verbatim quote. Differences in raw readings are never published on their own.

compare_with.name: Calilio
compare_with.why: Calilio is in our dossiers too, and it sells the phone service: per-user plans with numbers, minutes and SMS included. VanityNumber.com sells only the number, once, and you port it to the carrier or VoIP service you already pay. If you need both, you can buy the number here and run it on a service such as Calilio, provided that service accepts the port; check that before buying, because the number is non-refundable.

purchase.how: AIBuilder Marketplace does not sell this software. Sign up, start a trial or buy on the vendor's site.
purchase.disclosure: Where purchase.affiliate is true, purchase.handoff_url is our own review page for the product; the vendor button on that page is a marked affiliate link and AIBuilder Marketplace may earn a commission at no extra cost to the buyer. Commission never changes what a record says, and products are not ranked by commission. Where it is false the link is the vendor's plain site. Since schema 1.1 this API does not publish affiliate links.

exit_test.what: No account was needed; the tool ran without signing in. On 18 November 2026 the session searched the public site of Vanity Number without an account. PLUMBER as a local number returned no numbers, only a prompt to refine or reset the search, and DENTIST gave (603) DENTIST in Hinsdale, New Hampshire at $3,000.00. Toll-free LAW numbers cost $199.99 to $399.99. Only one-time prices per number were shown, with Add to cart as the way to buy, and no monthly price, set-up fee or per-minute price. The FAQ says that refunds are not possible. The dossier says prices start at $99.99; the lowest price seen was $199.99, but the cheapest number was not searched for. Nothing was bought and no screenshots were kept. Account and start: no account was used. Our AI assistant ran the test in a tab of our Chrome on vanitynumber.com, with no login (the interface is in English). The dossier name is Vanity Number and the review is on ZTS (zts/vanity-number-review.html). The test date is 18 Nov 2026; the start time was not recorded in the notes. Search 1: PLUMBER as a local number gave no list, only the message Please refine or reset your search to continue. and a Notify me form that asks for an e-mail address; it was not filled in. Search 2: DENTIST as a local number gave (603) DENTIST, Hinsdale, New Hampshire, $3,000.00. Toll-free without a search term: (844) 766-6660 $399.99 (20% off $499.99). Toll-free LAW numbers: (855) 636-3-LAW $199.99, (888) 313-1-LAW $199.99 (73% off $749.99) and (833) LAW-1919 $399.99, so the LAW numbers cost $199.99 to $399.99. Prices: vanitynumber.com, read by the tester on 18 Nov 2026 in US dollars, one-time price per number: a local DENTIST number in Hinsdale, New Hampshire at $3,000.00; toll-free numbers without a search term, for example (844) 766-6660 at $399.99 (20% off $499.99); LAW numbers (855) 636-3-LAW at $199.99, (888) 313-1-LAW at $199.99 (73% off $749.99) and (833) LAW-1919 at $399.99. No monthly price, set-up fee or per-minute price was shown, only the one-time price per number. There are no plans. The FAQ says Prices start at $99.99; the lowest price the tester saw was $199.99, but nobody searched for the cheapest number, so the claim was not tested. The FAQ also says that refunds are not possible. The way to buy: every number has the button Add to cart, which was not clicked, and there is a login link at the top right. No cart, checkout or card screen was opened. Cancelling: not applicable, there is no account and no subscription; the FAQ says refunds are not possible. Screenshots: none were kept, because the screens show stock photos of faces. Not tested: the shopping cart, the checkout, the Notify me e-mail form, the cheapest number and the third audience of the dossier (the phone service itself, which the site does not sell). Clean up: no account and no test data; the own tab was closed and nothing was bought or filled in. No kit records were entered.
exit_test.awkward: A search for PLUMBER gave no list at all, only a request to refine or reset the search. The local DENTIST number cost $3,000.00 and the LAW numbers $199.99 to $399.99, well above the $99.99 the FAQ says prices start at. Refunds are not possible. No screenshots exist because the screens show stock photos of faces.
